description: This file defines a tool for fetching session message history, including functions for sanitizing, truncating, and enforcing size limits on session history data, and a factory function to create the tool with configurable options.

methods.name: truncateHistoryText
methods.description: Redacts sensitive text and truncates it to a maximum character limit, indicating if truncation or redaction occurred.

methods.name: sanitizeHistoryContentBlock
methods.description: Sanitizes and truncates individual content blocks within session history, handling different content types such as images and thinking messages.

methods.name: sanitizeHistoryMessage
methods.description: Sanitizes and truncates entire session history messages, removing large or sensitive fields.

methods.name: enforceSessionsHistoryHardCap
methods.description: Ensures the total size of session history items does not exceed a maximum byte limit, truncating or replacing with a placeholder if necessary.

methods.name: createSessionsHistoryTool
methods.description: Factory function that creates a session history retrieval tool with optional configuration parameters.
